# Phosphor Icons

Source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core/tree/2b75f3ad12b420c9504ef05df8d2564a28f8500e

Only the 13 Regular and 4 Fill icons used by PengWa are bundled as Android Vector Drawables. Original 256 × 256 path geometry is preserved. MIT license: [phosphor-LICENSE.txt](phosphor-LICENSE.txt).

The same license is packaged in the APK at `assets/licenses/phosphor-LICENSE.txt`.
